entities.summary: Joseph Guo Jincai is a Chinese Catholic prelate who has served as Bishop of Chengde since 2010. He is also vice-president of Chinese Patriotic Catholic Association and China Committee on Religion and Peace. He was a deputy to the 13th National People's Congress.
